q: Calculate the percentage of PP tubs not recycled.
Suggest why PET bottles are recycled more than mixed films.
Bottles are one type of plastic, easy to collect and clean, with a good resale price; films are thin, dirty and mixed.
Explain why poly(ethene) and other addition polymers last so long in the environment.
Their long chains have strong C-C and C-H bonds and no weak points that microorganisms can break: they are not biodegradable.
